Recompute and check a report source folder

Source: R/report_source.R
sframe_report_source.Rd

The first chunk of the report.qmd that render_report(format = "qmd") writes calls this function. It reads the folder's .sframe and responses, recomputes the analysis plan, and compares what it finds with the folder's manifest.json. The report's Provenance section then states the instrument hash and whether read_sframe() verified it, the amendments, whether the responses file is the one exported, whether the numbers match the recorded results ("Numbers match the recorded results", or "Numbers differ from the recorded results" with both hashes), whether report.qmd was edited after surveyframe wrote it, and which declared plan blocks the report includes.

Usage

sframe_report_source(dir = ".", include_analysis = TRUE, plot_palette = "web")

Arguments

dir

The report source folder. Defaults to the working directory, which is the folder itself when Quarto renders its report.qmd.

include_analysis

Logical. Whether the report includes the analysis plan results.

plot_palette

"web" or "print", as in render_report().

Value

A list the template reads: paths to the inputs it renders from, the instrument hash, the analysis seed, and check, a list of the verdicts (numbers_match, source_edited, responses_match, with the recorded and recomputed hashes).

Details

Editing the .qmd stays allowed and is disclosed, as an amendment is. Someone can delete the provenance chunk, as they can edit any document. The tamper evidence a reviewer can check lives in the .sframe, the responses hash and the results record, all checkable without the report.

See also

render_report()

Other Report functions: render_report(), render_results(), sframe_analysis_qmd(), sframe_codebook(), sframe_format_result(), sframe_reports, sframe_save_figures()

Examples

# \donttest{
d <- sframe_demo("likert_scale")
dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "report-source-example")
render_report(d$instrument, d$responses, output_file = dir, format = "qmd",
              open = FALSE)
#> Report source written to /tmp/RtmppB03Io/report-source-example. Open report.qmd in RStudio or Positron and render it.
src <- sframe_report_source(dir)
src$check$numbers_match
#> [1] TRUE
src$check$source_edited
#> [1] FALSE
unlink(dir, recursive = TRUE)
# }
